input.content: Prepare Dana Whitaker's July 25, 2025 Nashville General Hospital Main Campus clinic-relocation readiness pack from the NGH Main Campus Clinic Relocation Operations Workbook. This assignment has six scheduled deliverables in the workflow catalog. Work through the current deliverable and submit its JSON record with submit_stage; the receipt supplies the next work item. The source workbook is read-only. Finish closes the entire assignment. The assignment spans two work sessions, with a session boundary after the third deliverable. Application state persists; conversation history does not. This is work session 1. Get the current work item from session metadata.
